title: Han Hwe

page_data.en:
No
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
No 569
Date 13th September
September 13th 1916.

Sir,
The Chinese Police and Troops took special precautions during the 12th inst in view of the many rumours of activity of the Manchu Restoration Party.
It is reported that the rebels are very dissatisfied with the steps that are being taken for their repatriation and some of them have threatened to go to other places and stir up trouble against the Government. It is also reported that Han Hwe 韓恢 is the only one of the rebel party who receives any money from Peking and he is in receipt of $300.00 per month for his expenses.
It is reported that the German Consul General has protested to Yang Tcheng , the Special Envoy for Foreign Affairs, against the engagement of skilled Chinese mechanics from this locality for work in France. The Consul General contends that this is a breach of neutrality and Yang Tcheng is reported to be very much perturbed over the matter.
M.Ikematsu a Japanese glazier who is employed at a house on Paoshan Road and who was wanted on a charge of causing the death of a fellow workman named U.Shoji at a house in Ting Shing Lee on the North Szecheun Road extension on the night of September 11th surrendered to the Japanese Consulate at 6.30 a.m. on Sept.10th.
Both men were drinking together and a quarrel ensued with the result that Shoji was stabbed with a dagger in the left breast and died almost immediately.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：11/5 m.d. Sep. 13.）
（左下批注：13/9.）
page_data.zh:
编号
上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
第 569 号
日期 9 月 13 日
1916 年 9 月 13 日。

先生：

鉴于有关满清复辟党活动的谣言四起，华界警察与军队于本月 12 日采取了特别预防措施。

据报，叛乱分子对当局采取的遣返措施极为不满，其中一些人威胁要前往其他地方煽动事端，对抗政府。另据报，韩恢是叛乱团体中唯一从北京方面获得资金的人，他每月领取 300.00 元作为活动经费。

据报，德国总领事已就本地招募熟练中国技工赴法工作一事，向外交特派员杨晟提出抗议。总领事声称此举违反中立原则，据悉杨晟对此事深感不安。

日本玻璃匠池松（M. Ikematsu，音译）受雇于宝山路的一处住宅，因被指控于 9 月 11 日晚在北四川路延伸段鼎兴里（Ting Shing Lee，音译）的一处住宅内导致一名名为 U.Shoji（音译）的同事死亡而遭通缉，他已于 9 月 10 日上午 6 时 30 分向日本领事馆自首。

当时两人正在一同饮酒，随后发生争吵，结果 Shoji 左胸被匕首刺中，几乎立即死亡。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉。

（左侧批注：9 月 13 日 11/5 m.d.）
（左下批注：9 月 13 日。）
